description: Use this when the user asks about Fantasy Premier League bonus points or BPS during or after Premier League matches: 'provisional bonus in Man Utd v Spurs', 'who's getting bonus?', 'is Saka on bonus?', 'live BPS'. Provisional bonus (3-2-1) from the live Bonus Points System for matches in play or finished this gameweek, and the BPS gap to the next bonus. Only useful on match days.

match.description: A club in the match, e.g. 'Man Utd' or 'Man Utd v Spurs'. Default: every match that has started.

player.description: A player's name: his BPS, rank in the match and gap to more bonus.
